entries.title: Round tabs and a roomier message box on your iPhone and iPad
entries.body: The lit tab at the top is now a circle, and Settings and the computer button are round beside it. A card you put aside is no longer a Minimized button on Home: Tasks lists it under Waiting on you, and a tap brings it back. The computer sheet opens at half height with Leave in its own section. Under the message box, dots show while your first mate works, a finished reply fades after you have had time to read it, and a tap on the reply opens it whole. The message box is taller, with a round send button.

picture.alt: The phone's top bar: a round Settings button, the house, checklist and pulse icons with the house lit in a circle, and a round computer button, above a card titled Choose the harbour.
